7.4.3.3.3.1 General requirements
[SWS_SwCluC_03502] Support of changing Host Software Cluster without
rebuilding Application Software Cluster
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈The Com Proxy shall support that the ComIPdu Ids of the Com of the Host Soft-
ware Cluster can change, without reconfiguration or rebuild of the Application
Software Cluster using these ComIPdus.⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_03548] Support of changing Application Software Cluster
without rebuilding Host Software Cluster
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈The Com Proxy shall support that the ComUserCbkHandleId of ComUserIPdus
configured in Com users of the Application Software Cluster can change,
without reconfiguration or rebuild of the Host Software Cluster.⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_03535] Invoke all the configured <ComUser_ComCbkRxIndica-
tion> if SwCluC_ComProxy_ComCbkRxIndication is called
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈If the <ComUser_ComCbkRxIndication> notification callback is configured in the
Com High Proxy (via the ComUserCallbackName (See [ECUC_Com_10036]) pa-
rameter, where the ComUserCallbackType (See [ECUC_Com_10034]) is set to
COM_RX_INDICATION), all the configured <ComUser_ComCbkRxIndication> call-
backs shall be invoked, when the associated instance of the SwCluC_ComProxy_
ComCbkRxIndication from the Com Low Proxy is called.⌋
